headline: On October 15, 1997: Cassini probe launches to Saturn
captionCards: Cassini was the first to orbit Saturn, 2004-2017
Cassini's data still provides insights into Saturn
instagramCaption:
Cassini-Huygens mission sets off for Saturn. \\[Blank Line]\\ The Cassini probe, a joint effort by NASA, ESA, and ASI, launched from Cape Canaveral on its journey to study Saturn and its moons. This was the first mission to orbit Saturn, staying there from 2004 to 2017. The Huygens lander, part of the mission, successfully landed on Titan, Saturn's largest moon. \\[Blank Line]\\ Today, Cassini's data continues to provide insights into Saturn's system. \\[Blank Line]\\ What do you think is the most fascinating discovery from Cassini? \\[Blank Line]\\ Follow @onthisday.reels for daily history ⏳
